transform_and_run_basic: transform a Haiku module function and run init then apply with a given seed
transform_and_run_no_apply: transform a Haiku function and run only init without calling apply
transform_and_run_with_jax_transform: transform a Haiku function with an optional JAX transform like pmap before init and apply
transform_and_run_interactive: quickly test a Haiku module in Jupyter or Colab by transforming and running it inline
transform_and_run_with_custom_rng: transform a Haiku function using a custom map_rng function to broadcast keys across devices
